steps.name: Epilogue ~ The Land of Illusions ~
steps.objective: Listen to the visitor who came to see [Siam], then complete the quest.

lines.text: (Alone in an empty space, Siam senses someone's presence.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Who's there?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Kazno. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: You're never one for many words, so I'll ask first. Did someone come with you?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno recommended you, and you've exceeded my expectations, mage. You noticed me even with my presence hidden?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Siam...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: This person needs your help.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's right, mage from another world. Kazno and I want to know something. Answer our questions, and I won't do anything.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I promise. I'm no savage beast. I won't hurt you.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: You do feel different. But this promise you mentioned... Is it some kind of contract?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Perhaps. Perhaps not. I can offer one if you want. It depends on whom you choose and what form it takes.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Understood. Then I'll tell you about the other world you wish to know.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Good! You're something else, mage. You already knew. Then tell me about 'A▒▒el'!

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A star's name I haven't heard in a long time. Where I came from...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Azrael... It means 'the star chosen by god's angel.' Oh, Kazno... Leaving?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I'll be going. I only brought someone who had business with you.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Before I leave, may I ask one thing? The choice you made then...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Like you, I have no regrets...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Goodbye, Kazno. I'll hear more about that star from him.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: And don't die before you find the serpent. You still need to see that couple again, don't you? Plenty left to do. Take care.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Enough nonsense... I'm leaving.
(Kazno disappears. Siam and Jeril speak for a long time, and Jeril looks satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Thank you. That helped a great deal. When this is over, Etoile will change in the direction everyone desires.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I'm not sure what you mean...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: At least it'll be better than now. Oh, you look like you have a question for me. Go on. What is it?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Is that person... also an Agasura?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Forced by fate to become a real one... Just like the one I knew.
